title: The filler is spending: it comes out of Free to spend for the period or periods its stretch covers, or out of the place the person picks (decision T2, final_review_3 finding 2, f8)
story: The person never logs spends; they check in at weekends. Set up Thu 10 Dec 2026, pay day: the bank holds 500,000, of which 100,000 is kept for a trip and 60,000 is Free to spend (typed); no budget lines. Pay of 300,000 on the 10th (moved earlier) starts the period. Sat 19 Dec check-in: the bank shows 450,000, so 50,000 went out unlogged; it comes out of Free to spend. Sat 26 Dec check-in: 440,000; the person says the 10,000 was trip bookings and picks the trip place for that filler. Fri 8 Jan the pay is ticked (pay@2027-01-10, moved earlier from Sunday). Mon 11 Jan check-in: 708,000; the 32,000 filler's stretch, 27 Dec to 11 Jan, crosses the period start and is split by days. Every amount is made up.

events.note: the person picked the trip place for this filler
